G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies the variable domains, constraint format and bounds, feasibility output, lexicographic tie-break rule, and all relevant edge cases.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The rewritten task is equivalent to assigning one of two shifts so every conflicting pair receives different values, including the same bounds, outputs, and lexicographic requirement.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is clear and readable overall, though the set-based formulation is somewhat more elaborate than the natural conflict-pair wording.
